name: IQTest
intro: IQTest 是 MathVista 新建的 228 题视觉逻辑子集，题目来自在线学习平台的智力测试图形，覆盖归纳、抽象、模式预测与计算。STEM 研究生人工标注并由三位评审独立核验，再按 MathVista 的答案抽取、归一化与精确准确率协议评测。
org: UCLA, University of Washington, Microsoft Research
build_method: 从在线学习平台收集智力测试图形；STEM 研究生人工标注；三人独立复核；共识消歧
task_type: 图形问答, 视觉逻辑与算术推理
eval_feature: 归纳, 抽象, 模式预测, 图形计算, 确定性答案归一化
task_type_en: Figure QA, Visual Logical and Arithmetic Reasoning
build_method_en: Collect puzzle-test figures from online learning platforms, annotate them with STEM graduate students, conduct three independent reviews, and resolve disagreements by consensus
eval_feature_en: Induction, Abstraction, Pattern Prediction, Visual Calculation, Deterministic Answer Normalization
intro_en: IQTest is MathVista's newly created 228-example visual-logic subset. It sources puzzle-test figures from online learning platforms and tests induction, abstraction, pattern prediction, and calculation. STEM graduate students annotate the items, three reviewers independently verify them, and MathVista extracts, normalizes, and exactly scores model answers.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with the IQTest portions of MathVista arXiv:2310.02255v3 Sections 2.2-2.4, 3.1, Appendix C.4/D.3, official Git revision 53d525874bdde205128e6b160b7357a88277d479, and Hugging Face dataset revision 2b6ad69445fbb5695c9b165475e8decdbeb97747. IQTest is one of MathVista's three newly created datasets. It contains 228 puzzle-test figure questions sourced from online learning platforms and targets induction, abstract thinking, pattern prediction, logical reasoning, and calculations. Graduate students in STEM fields manually annotate questions and answers. Each new dataset is independently checked by three reviewers; across the 736 newly annotated MathVista questions, answer agreement is 99.2%, with six disagreements resolved through full-team discussion. The pinned official release contains 37 IQTest testmini rows and 191 test rows. Evaluation directly accepts already-short choices or integers and otherwise uses the GPT-4 answer extractor validated above 99.5% on 200 examples, normalizes option, integer, float, or list formats, and reports deterministic exact accuracy. GPT-4 is an answer extractor, not a scoring judge.
